meta.title: Bead Studio
meta.description: Turn pictures into bead patterns with deterministic color reduction, generic IDs, board views, material counts and printable exports. No chat-model calls.

ui.title: Bead Studio
ui.subtitle: Turn your favorite pictures into patterns you can build.
ui.drop: Drop an image here or upload one
ui.formats: PNG / JPG / WebP · Up to 12 MB
ui.privacy: Normal pattern conversion stays local and uses no model. AI sends a reference only after explicit consent. Codex retains conversation attachments; the custom API UI workflow does not write chat records.
ui.backgroundNote: Handles existing transparency only; no background removal. Up to 128 × 128 beads.
ui.heightCapped: Height capped at 128. Reduce width to preserve the original aspect ratio.
ui.dirty: Conversion settings changed. Preview and export still use this pattern; generating again will replace it.
ui.zoomHint: Vector preview · 32 pixels per cell at 100%. Choose 100%–400% to read color IDs and scroll in both directions. Fit width is for the overview.
ui.viewportHint: Left-drag pans in View mode. In Edit mode use middle button or Space + left-drag to pan; Ctrl/Cmd + wheel zooms around the pointer.
ui.previewAria: Bead grid with color IDs and row/column coordinates
ui.emptyTitle: Your first pattern starts with a picture
ui.emptyText: Upload an image and generate, or try the built-in cat.
ui.exportNote: PNG / SVG export this view. PDF includes materials and all boards. JSON is a reopenable project. Click the prepared file link to download.
ui.generated: Pattern ready. Bold borders show board boundaries; dotted empty cells need no beads.
ui.downloaded: Download requested. Check your browser or DSH download notice.
ui.paletteNote: C IDs belong to this pattern only. Match HEX reference colors to actual beads; screen colors are not physical color guarantees.
ui.noPalette: Generate a pattern to see colors and counts.
ui.memoryNote: Wait for Synced before leaving; export JSON if saving fails. The library does not store source images; AI image retention depends on the selected engine notice. Undo history lasts this session only.
ui.fileError: Choose a PNG, JPG or WebP image up to 12 MB.
ui.pixelError: Image exceeds 20 megapixels. Resize it first.
ui.exportSize: Image is too large. Select one board to export.
ui.popupError: Print popup blocked. Allow popups for this page and retry.
ui.saveScope: Autosaves to the current artwork; edit its name directly. Generating and importing create separate artworks. Source images are not stored. Deleted works go to the recycle bin.
ui.restored: Artwork opened. Edit and export directly; select an image to regenerate.
ui.sourceNotStored: Pattern restored; the library does not store source images. Upload a reference again.
ui.previousRetained: New image loaded. Check the planned grid size; the current artwork stays unchanged until generation succeeds.
ui.imported: Imported as a new artwork without overwriting the original.
ui.conflictHint: Autosave paused to avoid overwriting another window. Export your current JSON, then restore the latest saved project.
ui.reloadConfirm: Reloading discards unsaved local changes. Export JSON first.
ui.highlightHint: Click a color to highlight it; click again to restore. Highlighting changes only the view, never the pattern, counts or exported colors.
ui.download_ready: File ready. Click the download link below.
ui.download_requested: Browser download requested. Check its download notice; this does not confirm a completed save.
ui.download_cancelled: Save cancelled. The download remains available.
ui.download_error: Export or save failed. See the error above.
ui.downloadHint: Prepare a format, then click its download link. A Save as button appears when supported. Cancellation never silently starts another download.
ui.recoveryHint: An unsaved draft is available. Restoring creates a separate copy. Closing the app loses the in-memory draft.
ui.editHint: Left-drag previews immediately; release commits one stroke. Pan with middle button or Space + left-drag. Focus the canvas for Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Shift+Z; keeps 50 session steps.
ui.viewHint: View mode pans without changing cells.
ui.hoverHint: Hover a cell for its coordinates, board and color.
ui.previewOnly: Preview only, not saved; confirm to apply with undo
ui.replaceWarning: A new artwork will open. The saved current artwork is retained, but this page’s undo history will clear. Export JSON first if needed.
ui.pickedEmpty: This cell is empty. Choose a palette color or use the eraser.
ui.viewportEditHint: Left-drag previews immediately; release commits one stroke. Pan with middle button or Space + left-drag. Focus the canvas for Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Shift+Z; keeps 50 session steps.
ui.purgeWarning: Permanent deletion cannot be undone. Confirm:
ui.trashWarning: Move to the recycle bin; it can be restored later:
ui.keepImageSize: Keep width and crop when replacing the image
ui.aiWarning: AI may change appearance, markings and details. This is not a faithful background cutout.
ui.aiPrivacy: Both the reference image and generated results will be stored in the selected DSH conversation and attachment storage. The reference is sent as a user-request attachment to the Codex image service using subscription quota. The actual price is unknown. The artwork library still stores patterns only; the upload source is not replaced until you confirm adoption.
ui.aiConsent: I consent to storing this reference and generated results in the selected conversation and attachment storage and sending the reference to the Codex image service, with subscription quota usage and possible image changes.
ui.aiSessionNote: Availability only means the tool entry exists. Session model permissions, login and quota are checked during execution. Requests may be refused; no automatic retries or model/conversation switching. Choose an idle conversation and avoid sending chat messages while generating.
ui.aiUnavailable: The AI engine is not connected or is unavailable
ui.aiCancelled: Waiting cancelled; the remote request may already be charged. No automatic retry.
ui.aiAdoptHint: Adopting only replaces the upload source; it does not save an artwork or generate a pattern. Click Generate afterward to create a new artwork.
ui.aiAdopted: Candidate adopted. You can now generate a pattern.
ui.aiTestEntry: AI Source Assistant · Experimental (off until requested)
ui.aiSourceReady: AI candidate adopted as the upload source. The saved artwork is unchanged. Check the planned size, then generate a separate artwork.
ui.aiNeedSource: Upload a reference under Select Image below. Restoring a saved pattern does not provide a source photo for AI.
ui.aiApiKey: API key (blank preserves an existing key only at the same URL)
ui.aiCustomHelp: HTTPS public OpenAI-compatible images/edits only; /images/edits is appended to the base URL. Not all providers are compatible.
ui.aiKeyStorage: Keys are stored by DSH host credentials. The default local backend uses plaintext files protected by file permissions, not an encrypted vault. Use a dedicated key with a spending limit.
ui.aiConfirmClear: Confirm deletion of configuration and key (artworks are unaffected)
ui.aiCheckHelp: Validates saved configuration only. Does not test connectivity, login or quota, or send an image.
ui.aiCustomPrivacy: The current image will be sent to the base URL shown below and use that provider’s quota; the actual price is unknown. No Codex or chat session is used. This workbench keeps candidates temporarily in memory; projects do not store source images. Provider-side image retention follows its own policies.
ui.aiCustomConsent: I consent to sending this image to the displayed base URL and using that provider’s quota, and understand possible image changes.
ui.aiSaved: Configuration saved. Please confirm consent again.
ui.aiAddressChanged: Changing the base URL requires entering a new API key.
ui.aiReadModels: Connect and read models (online, no image generation)
ui.aiModelsHelp: Only clicking sends authentication to the entered base URL for GET /models. No image is uploaded and editing capability is not verified.
ui.aiModelsPlaceholder: Choose explicitly; nothing is saved automatically
ui.aiModelsUnverified: Image candidates are filtered by name only; editing is unverified. Show all models or keep entering an ID manually.
ui.aiModelsEmpty: No matching models. Show all or enter an ID manually.
ui.aiModelsTruncated: The model list was truncated; exact IDs can still be entered manually.
ui.aiModelsKey: On success, a newly entered key stays only in frontend memory for saving configuration. It is not displayed or written to projects or chats, and is cleared on failure.
